_comment: Merge the 'mcpServers.solidworks' entry into your Claude Desktop config.
_instructions: 1. Replace C:\\path\\to\\solidworks-mcp with the absolute path to your clone.
2. Replace the python path with the path to your venv's python.exe.
3. Merge the mcpServers block into your existing claude_desktop_config.json.
5. Look for the hammer icon in the chat toolbar.
